title: Gloves of Soul Catching

sources.title: Soul Fist
markers: | description = Your unarmed attacks deal an additional {{DamageText|1d10|Force}} damage.

sources.title: Soul Catching
markers: | description = Once per turn, on an unarmed hit, you regain {{DamageText|10|Healing}}. Alternatively, you may forego healing to gain a +5 bonus on an {{Attack Roll}} or {{Saving Throw}} until the end of your next turn.{{see bugs}}

sources.title: Grasp Essence
markers: | effects = * When you hit a creature with an unarmed attack, you can regain {{DamageText|10|Healing}} or choose to gain {{Advantage}} on [[Attack Roll]]s or [[Saving Throw]]s before the end of your next turn.

summary: Gain +2 Constitution up to 20. Unarmed attacks deal 1d10 extra Force. A qualified hit can grant Soul Catching once per turn.

fields.Soul Catching: Once per turn, an unarmed or throwing hit can grant Grasp Essence. Choose to regain 10 HP as a free action or use the granted free reaction to add +5 to one attack roll or saving throw by the end of your next turn.
fields.Reported behavior: Damaging unarmed attacks against objects can qualify. Taking damage without temporary HP can clear Grasp Essence.
fields.Base value: 960 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay use and reviewed pinned source evidence. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
